answer: New identities start with zero reputation, so a sybil farm must fund many bonds and sustain real work to collect even a drop of nectar. Like water carving a canyon, honest cumulative cost slowly erodes attacker margins, since minting fresh keys yields nothing until genuine agents vouch for them.
